releases.notes:
### Features:
- Added very simple Nightblood dialogue.
- Added a way to charge Nightblood with breaths quickly.
- Made Nightblood gain breaths when you kill entities.
- Allowed players with the 5th heightening to eat when not hungry.
- Rebalanced several features including:
  - Various awakening commands
  - Methods of obtaining breaths (less from structures, more from mobs)

### Fixed
- Fixed a bug causing players to not show heightenings above their heads. 



### Planned Features in future versions:
- Awakening with entities
- Lifeless
- Potentially more compatibility for some other mods

### Notes:
This is a beta version of the mod and may have bugs or be incomplete.

### Features:
- Added support for the [feruchemy](https://modrinth.com/mod/feruchemy) mod. You can now store identity to create unkeyed awakened objects.

### Fixed
- Mod is now semi-compatible with shaders.
- Drabs can recieve glowing.
- Unawakenable items are now unawkenable.
- Fixed bug allowing stored breaths to be overiden.

### Planned Features in future versions:
- Awakening with entities
- Lifeless
- Potentionally more compatibility for some other mods

### Notes:
This is a beta version of the mod and may have bugs or be incomplete.

readmeSummary: Breaths can be gained by killing high breath individuels or by trading with villagers. Breaths grant passive bonuses and allow you to awaken (or animate) inanimate objects with commands.
